title: Gnawing, Biting, Hacking, Burning
text: Each time a regroup action discards an <symbol>isengard</symbol> Orc, you may stack that Orc on this card. <keyword>Shadow:</keyword> Discard 2 cards stacked here and remove <symbol>twilight1</symbol>to play an <symbol>isengard</symbol> Orc from your discard pile.
